_about: Every US prediction-market platform the Ledger records or tracks. `collector` names the module in collectors/ that captures it, or null when nothing public is exposed yet. `cftc_org` is the organization code the CFTC uses on its filings lists. Edit by pull request; never delete a row, set `status` instead.

platforms.name: Kalshi
platforms.notes: Events with nested markets; multivariate (combo) collections excluded from the record and counted separately.

platforms.name: Polymarket US
platforms.notes: Public gateway. `limit` caps at 500; `offset` pages; `page` is ignored by the server.

platforms.name: Gemini Predictions
platforms.notes: Events with nested contracts and top-of-book. Every query is capped at 1,000 events; the collector walks per category and flags truncation.

platforms.name: Novig
platforms.notes: Sports Trading API announced Oct 2026; access terms not yet read. Not captured.

platforms.name: ProphetX
platforms.notes: Market data needs an affiliate key. Not captured.

platforms.name: Rothera
platforms.notes: Robinhood and Susquehanna. No public market-data API found yet.

platforms.name: DKeX
platforms.notes: DraftKings, on Railbird. No public market-data API found yet.

platforms.name: Public
platforms.notes: Routes to Kalshi; Kalshi's record covers its listings.

platforms.name: Tribal apps on Kalshi
platforms.notes: SaltTrade, PokkeTrades, Sovereign Edge, Greenville, AIR Markets. Kalshi's record covers their listings.
